places.name: Warwick Sewer Authority plant
places.note: The maps show the levee as raised in 2014-17; in 2010 the survey marked water inside the plant. The maps' dry ground here is today's, not 2010's.

i95_record: Reported: a stretch of Interstate 95 in Warwick was closed by Tuesday March 30 and reopened Thursday April 1, southbound first (AP and CBS reports of those days). No hour is on the record read here.
